name: 80219 · Denver, CO
findings: ZIP 80219 (Denver) has 116 nonprofit organizations. 47 of them (41%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 40 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (38% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 80219 (Denver) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
